subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: The Surgeon General's Warning
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Surgeon General's Warning usable.

hook.text: In 2023, the US Surgeon General warned that social media poses a 'profound risk' to children's mental health.

buildup.text: The advisory cited rising rates of anxiety, depression, and loneliness among teens correlated with social media use.

discovery.text: The Surgeon General called on platforms to share data with researchers and adopt safety-by-design for minors.

twist.text: The warning has no legal force. Unlike tobacco warnings, it can't compel platforms to change anything.

climax.text: America's top doctor says social media harms kids. Platforms are free to ignore the warning entirely.

punchline.text: A surgeon general's warning. No teeth behind it.

quiz.question: What did the US Surgeon General's 2023 advisory say about social media?
options: Social media poses a profound risk to children's mental health
Social media is completely safe for all ages
Only TikTok poses a risk to children
